verdict.rationale: YYLO is a local command-line orchestrator for coding agents. A multi-user or organization feature for creating sessions on behalf of others is a fair question for this kind of product, but the evidence shows no user accounts, organization roles, impersonation, or delegated session creation. The 'delegate bounded work across agents and models' claim is about distributing work among agents, not acting on behalf of other users, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can create agent sessions on behalf of other users in my organization
